name: spark-band
description: A band above the prompt with a remote Linux box's free memory, GPU processes and load, read over ssh

host.title: Host
host.description: The ssh alias of the machine to watch (read-only commands, key login). Empty: the band stays off.

onlyIn.title: Only in folders containing
onlyIn.description: Read the host only in sessions whose folder path contains this text. Empty: every session.

intervalSeconds.title: Interval (seconds)
intervalSeconds.description: How often to read the host while a session is open; never less than 60.

lowGb.title: Low memory (GB)
lowGb.description: Free memory below this draws the band in the warning colour.
